title: Double-well potential

title: Double-well stationary density

title: Linear state-space flow

title: Diffusive mean-square displacement
fact: For isotropic Brownian diffusion, mean-square displacement grows linearly with time and dimension.

title: Heat-kernel diffusion propagator
fact: The diffusion kernel broadens while its peak decreases, preserving total probability.

title: Landauer erasure bound versus temperature
fact: The minimum work associated with logically irreversible one-bit erasure scales linearly with absolute temperature.

title: Two-state directional KL asymmetry
fact: KL divergence vanishes only when the two Bernoulli laws coincide and grows sharply toward opposing deterministic limits.

title: Markov spectral mixing
fact: For an ergodic finite Markov chain, the subdominant eigenvalue magnitude controls asymptotic mixing rate.

title: Controllability Gramian growth
equation: Wc(T)=integral_0^T exp(At) B B^T exp(A^T t) dt
fact: For this stable controllable system, the finite-horizon Gramian grows toward a finite infinite-horizon limit.

title: Correlated Gaussian contours
fact: Off-diagonal covariance rotates elliptical equal-density contours, encoding statistical dependence.

title: KL divergence for Gaussian mean shifts
fact: With equal variance, Gaussian KL divergence grows quadratically with normalized mean separation.

title: Bernoulli Fisher information
fact: Under direct Bernoulli parameterization, Fisher information is smallest at p=1/2 and diverges toward the boundaries.

title: Gaussian mutual information
fact: For jointly Gaussian scalars, mutual information depends only on |rho| and diverges as |rho| approaches one.

title: Gaussian total variation under mean shift
fact: Total variation rises from zero toward one as two equal-variance Gaussian laws separate.

title: Intervention-conditioned response laws
fact: Different interventions can induce distinguishable future response distributions, the primitive objects of the causal-structure construction.

title: Intervention response-geometry matrix
fact: The matrix is symmetric with zero diagonal because total variation is a metric on probability laws.

title: Directed interventional influence matrix
equation: A_ij^p(tau)=sup TV(P_j^u, P_j^v) over source-i intervention pairs
fact: Directed influence is generally asymmetric; source-to-target effects need not equal target-to-source effects.

title: Partition irreducibility versus coupling
fact: For the displayed balanced binary family, the product-factorization defect grows linearly with coupling.

title: Coupled binary joint response law
fact: Uniform marginals can coexist with a dependent joint law; one-variable marginals alone do not reveal the coupling.

title: Response-level coupling defect
fact: For this balanced binary family, the factorization defect is zero only at independence and grows with |rho|.

title: TV contraction under coarse binning
fact: Successive deterministic bin merging cannot increase total-variation distinguishability.

title: Exact coarse-graining collision
fact: A many-to-one map can collapse maximally distinct point-mass laws to an identical coarse law.

title: Reconstruction defect versus decoder mismatch
fact: With fixed coarse mass, reconstruction error is governed by mismatch between the decoder and the true within-fiber conditional structure.

title: P18 scale-identifiability margin
fact: The coarse family is certified identifiable whenever fine-family separation exceeds twice the reconstruction defect.

title: Exact family sufficiency despite a many-to-one map
equation: rho_F=0 => d_f=d_c on the declared family
fact: Fixed within-fiber conditionals allow a globally many-to-one map to preserve all pairwise distances on a restricted family.

title: Temporal causal-fingerprint trajectory
fact: A time-indexed structural fingerprint traces a path through feature space; representation alignment precedes physical comparison.

title: Cumulative temporal path variation
fact: Cumulative path variation is nondecreasing because it sums nonnegative adjacent structural distances.

title: Temporal certification interval width
fact: Under an illustrative 1/sqrt(n) error schedule, certified temporal-distance intervals shrink at the same rate.

title: Categorical sample complexity versus gap

fact: The sufficient sample requirement scales quadratically as the inverse robust separation gap.

title: Empirical TV-distance convergence
fact: Repeated categorical simulations show empirical TV converging toward population TV as sample size increases.

title: Robust signature gap
fact: Increasing nuisance spread reduces the robust gap one-for-one; positive gap is necessary before finite-error recovery margins can be positive.

title: Repeated-event Hoeffding error bound
